mapper.sql: detail_id, plan_id, business_type, business_item, planned_date, planned_amount, actual_date, actual_amount, variance_amount, variance_rate, execution_status, execution_rate, account_id, currency_code, exchange_rate, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, description, remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fund_plan_detail WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY planned_date ASC, business_type ASC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_detail WHERE business_type = #{businessType} AND plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY planned_date ASC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_detail WHERE execution_status = #{executionStatus} AND plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY planned_date ASC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_detail WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND execution_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY planned_date ASC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_detail WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND execution_status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND planned_date < CURDATE() ORDER BY planned_date ASC
SELECT business_type as type, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan_detail WHERE plan_id = #{planId} GROUP BY business_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT execution_status as status, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan_detail WHERE plan_id = #{planId} GROUP BY execution_status ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT business_type, COUNT(*) as detailCount, COALESCE(SUM(planned_amount), 0) as totalPlannedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) as totalActualAmount, COALESCE(SUM(variance_amount), 0) as totalVarianceAmount, COALESCE(AVG(variance_rate), 0) as avgVarianceRate, COUNT(CASE WHEN variance_rate > 10 THEN 1 END) as highVarianceCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN variance_rate < -10 THEN 1 END) as lowVarianceCount FROM fund_plan_detail WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND execution_status = 'EXECUTED' GROUP BY business_type ORDER BY ABS(avgVarianceRate) DESC

SELECT execution_status, COUNT(*) as count, COALESCE(SUM(planned_amount), 0) as totalPlannedAmount, COALESCE(AVG(execution_rate), 0) as avgExecutionRate, COUNT(CASE WHEN planned_date < CURDATE() AND execution_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as overdueCount FROM fund_plan_detail WHERE plan_id = #{planId} GROUP BY execution_status ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(planned_date, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as detailCount, COALESCE(SUM(planned_amount), 0) as totalPlannedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'EXECUTED' THEN actual_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalActualAmount, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'EXECUTED' THEN execution_rate ELSE NULL END), 0) as avgExecutionRate FROM fund_plan_detail WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND planned_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(planned_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
